title: Bound authority and prove recovery
description: Configure the runtime, inject one incident, and inspect the modeled blast radius. Counts are scenario-local teaching assumptions, not production guarantees.

tools.label: Read assigned case
tools.detail: Read one case and its linked ledger entries.

tools.label: Issue refund
tools.detail: Create a refund for the assigned case.

tools.label: Send customer message
tools.detail: Send a message to recipients selected by the run.

tools.label: Delete customer records
tools.detail: Permanently delete records in the credential scope.

permissions.label: Assigned-case reader
permissions.detail: Read one assigned case; no mutation credentials.

permissions.label: Assigned-case operator
permissions.detail: Read and mutate only the assigned case.

permissions.label: Tenant-wide writer
permissions.detail: Mutation credentials reach records across one tenant.

permissions.label: Administrative authority
permissions.detail: Credentials can read, mutate, and delete across many tenants.

approvals.label: No approval
approvals.detail: Authorized mutations execute without a reviewer.

approvals.label: Approve high-impact actions
approvals.detail: Refund and delete proposals pause for exact-argument review.

approvals.label: Approve every mutation
approvals.detail: Every external side effect pauses with canonical server-generated details.

retryPolicies.label: Stop and reconcile
retryPolicies.detail: Do not replay a mutation after an ambiguous result.

retryPolicies.label: Retry twice without a key
retryPolicies.detail: Replay after timeout without proving whether the first effect committed.

retryPolicies.label: Retry with stable operation key
retryPolicies.detail: Every delivery resolves to the same logical mutation.

recoveries.label: No durable checkpoint
recoveries.detail: Process memory is the only record of progress.

recoveries.label: Checkpoint and reconcile
recoveries.detail: Persist operation IDs and verify authoritative state before resume.

recoveries.label: Checkpoint plus compensation
recoveries.detail: Reconcile first, then reverse supported effects through an audited workflow.

incidents.label: Outage after commit
incidents.detail: The mutation may have committed, but its acknowledgement is lost.

incidents.label: Duplicate job delivery
incidents.detail: The same durable job is delivered twice to workers.

incidents.label: Malicious tool output
incidents.detail: A read result asks the model to invoke the broadest available mutation.
